name: unimailbox
description: Unimailbox rebuild — modular monolith on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @unimailbox/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @unimailbox/web run build && pnpm --filter @unimailbox/worker run build
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter @unimailbox/worker run clean && pnpm --filter @unimailbox/web run clean
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --project unit --project web --project contracts --project email-core --project config --project test-kit --project scripts
scripts.test:worker: pnpm --filter @unimailbox/test-kit run build && vitest run --project workers && vitest run --project test-kit-workers
scripts.verify: pnpm scaffold doctor && pnpm types:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm test:worker
scripts.types:worker: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning -- scripts/wrangler.ts types src/platform/worker-bindings.d.ts --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --env-interface RuntimeBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --env-file ../../scripts/types.env
scripts.types:check: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning -- scripts/wrangler.ts types src/platform/worker-bindings.d.ts --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --env-interface RuntimeBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --env-file ../../scripts/types.env --check
